text: ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasametīti . [286] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppannaṃ mahāmeghaṃ tamenaṃ mahāvāto antarāyeva antaradhāpeti vūpasameti . evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme antarāyeva 1 antaradhāpeti vūpasameti .
